findings.summary: Slug-prefix globs attribute another task's SPEC/REVIEW files to this slug
findings.suggestion: Accept only REVIEW-<slug>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md (regex) and SPEC-<slug>.md / SPEC-<slug>.machine.yaml.

reasoning.trace: slug A prefix of slug B; worktrees carry other tasks' committed docs
reasoning.infer: A reads B's REVIEW/SPEC; wrong next_stage
reasoning.conclude: artifact-derived next_stage wrong for hyphen-prefix slugs

findings.summary: Whole span ledger read into memory, contradicting streamed-once constraint
findings.suggestion: Stream lines and keep newest row per slug.

findings.summary: next_stage runs for every worktree before the MAX_TASKS slice; no total deadline
findings.suggestion: Slice to newest MAX_TASKS before next_stage; add a monotonic deadline and report unavailable/null on overrun.

reasoning.observe: next_stage for every worktree before slicing; _verify_done -> compute_relevant_skip_key runs git + tool --version with 30s timeouts
reasoning.conclude: unbounded wall time breaks cheap never-fails contract

findings.summary: _verify_done runs git diff in live task worktrees; may take index.lock (a write)
findings.suggestion: Run git with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 / --no-optional-locks, or avoid git in the worktree.

reasoning.observe: git diff in wt via verification_cache
reasoning.infer: concurrent session's git add/commit can fail
reasoning.conclude: read-only briefing can interfere with git index

findings.summary: Worktree vanishing mid-scan voids the digest or yields a bogus next_stage
findings.suggestion: Guard iterdir with OSError; skip tasks whose .git vanished after next_stage.

reasoning.infer: whole digest unavailable or next_stage research

findings.summary: AC-009 reference is a monkeypatched stub of intent_cli.status_report, not the real payload
findings.suggestion: Add one unstubbed case with a real intent.yaml fixture compared to real status_report.
